name: entangle
lore:
### The Rite of Verdant Restraint: Entangle

To cast *Entangle* is to awaken the slumbering hunger of the soil. As you shape the Weave, the sensation is not a spark, but a heavy, viscous pulse—akin to pulling thick sap through one’s own marrow. It is stubborn magic, demanding a firm will to direct the earth's sudden, verdant fury.

Visually, the transformation is jarring. Soft clover thickens into leathery thongs; dormant roots erupt like the grasping fingers of a buried titan. The air fills with the sharp scent of crushed fern and damp loam as the flora binds all within its reach in a suffocating, emerald embrace.

Loremasters trace this rite to the **Green-Sleeper**, a hermit of the First Age. Besieged by iron-shod invaders, he did not strike with lightning. Instead, he whispered a secret to the grass. By dawn, the forest had reclaimed the camp, the soldiers held fast by vines that refused to let go even after the hermit’s breath had stilled. Tread softly, traveler; the roots have long memories.
